description: Register a manual or electric grinder with its dial settings scheme.

catalog_id.description: Optional — the maintenance catalog model this is (the `id` of a catalog row, e.g. rancilio-silvia), when it was registered from the catalog. Its maintenance then comes from that model's researched record. "none" says it is not in the catalog.

components_spec.description: JSON mapping string representing compound adjustment math

microns_per_step.description: Optional mechanical burr travel microns per nominal step

name.description: The name/model of the grinder, e.g. Kinu M47

nominal_step.description: Smallest adjustment increment (e.g. 1 click or 0.1collar units)

setting_scheme.description: Collar mark style: single clicks or compound (rotation.number.clicks)

name: register_grinder
title: Register a grinder
